settings.content:
Domestic Shipping

For domestic shipping, we send all orders within 48 hours of receiving them. Orders are shipped via FedEx, UPS, or US Postal Service and carrier tracking number will be provided once order is shipped. Shipping withing the contiguous 48 states are FREE. Shipping to Hawaii and Alaska will have extra shipping charge.

Shipping to US unincorporated territories, such as Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, Puerto Rico, United States Virgin Islands will have extra shipping charge.

Commercial items and oversized/overweight items may be subject to an additional shipping fee. For business customers, shipping is NOT FREE. Freight, LTL, FTL, palletized shipments will need to be quoted separately.

If you have special requirements for your shipping, contact us at:

714-202-0019, 9:30am-5pm PST, Monday-Friday.
Or email us: support@metpure.com

settings.title: International Shipping
settings.content: Shipments outside of the US for orders placed over the internet will have total shipping cost, including postage, handling fee, duty, and applicable VAT calculated separately. The calculated cost will then be added to the total to be paid for the order to be shipped out. Please contact Metpure customer service for an estimate of international shipping costs.

settings.title: P.O. Boxes
settings.content: We only ship to P.O. Boxes through USPS. Please check with your local post office if your package size/weight will exceed the limit allowed.

settings.title: Deliver Dates
settings.content:
Metpure Inc. does not deliver on weekends or major holidays. We will only ship to the address you have provided in the shipping address detail when you checked out. Metpure Inc. will not be responsible for non-delivered packages if the provided address was input incorrectly during check out.

You must contact Metpure Inc. immediately for any tracked packages that showed delivered but did not show up. Metpure Inc. will not be responsible for any packages that are correctly delivered but stolen. Metpure Inc. does not accept responsibility and has no control for shipping delays caused by shipping carriers.

settings.title: Order Cancellation
settings.content:
If your order item has not been shipped, you can cancel your order. Email our customer support staff: Support@metpure.com

If your item has already been picked up by the carrier, order cannot be canceled and you will need to go through our Returns procedure to get a refund.

settings.title: Shipment Refusal
settings.content: Do not refuse your shipment without an RMA Number. All returns must have an RMA Number. If you refuse a shipment without an RMA Number, no refund will be provided. If you have already obtained an RMA Number, you can apply it to the shipment and refuse it. Shipping charges will be applied to the balance of your refund.

settings.title: Return Shipment
settings.content: When returning a product, use its original box. If you no longer have the original box, use a box of the same dimensions. Make sure to wrap the parts in plastic before shipping.To prevent return shipping damage, repack the product in the same manner that it originally came with.Include everythingthat was shipped to you in the original box, including all parts, manual, and any free promotional items.Drain all waterfrom any product before shipping.To avoid refund deductions, unless defective or damaged, return all products in resell-as-new condition.Include receipt along with your RMA Numberin the return shipment box. Send package to: Metpure Inc. ATTN: Returns Department 4773 Brooks St., Unit D Montclair, CA 91763

settings.title: Refund Policy
settings.content:
30-day Money Back Guarantee Period

If you are not satisfied with your purchased product within 30 days of the original purchase date, return the product to Metpure Inc for a full refund.

*Must meet terms and conditions listed below.*

‎

Product defect, damaged, or our error return 

If the product is returned due to product defect, damaged, or our error within 30 days of the original purchase date, Metpure Inc. will refund 100% of the product purchase price, including shipping and return costs, upon receiving the product return. If a replacement is arranged, then no refund will be provided. 

‎

Returns due to reasons other than product defect, damaged, or our error

To receive refunds or replacements,all returns must be done within 30 days of the original purchase date. After 30 days, returns and replacements are subject to General Warranty Policy.

‎

If your product was returned due to reasons other than product defect, damaged, or our error,the product must be returned in resell-as-new condition, meaning that it can be resold right away in its return condition and packaging, to receive a full product refund.

‎

If the product was returned used and was not defective, orif cannot be resold in resell-as-new condition, depending on the return product condition determined by Metpure, up to 50% fee will be applied to the balance of the product refund.

‎

If the product was returned incomplete, depending on the return product condition determined by Metpure, up to 50% fee will be applied to the balance of the product refund.

‎

All original shipping and return shipping costs are the customer’s responsibilityunless the return is due to product defect, damaged, or our error.
